# Courseyl
> Turn any YouTube video or playlist into a structured, distraction-free interactive course you actually finish.
> Official Website: https://www.courseyl.online

## Overview
Courseyl (https://www.courseyl.online) is a premier AI-powered learning platform founded by Mr. Sami to solve online study fragmentation. It ingests long-form educational videos and playlists from YouTube, transforming them into modular, day-by-day learning plans with adaptive diagnostic placement tests, active recall quizzes with video timestamp replay, and rich interactive study notes.

## Key Flagship Features
1. **Curriculum-Grounded Placement Tests:**
   Adaptive diagnostic assessments that evaluate a learner's existing proficiency across the curriculum. When a learner demonstrates mastery, Courseyl automatically skips those modules, saving dozens of study hours.
2. **15h–24h+ Marathon Video Distribution:**
   Unlike traditional wrappers that cap lessons to 1 hour or truncate chapters, Courseyl proportionally distributes even 20+ hour comprehensive university lectures and coding bootcamps across full multi-day study bins.
3. **Smart Quiz Replay & Concept Rewind:**
   Interactive active-recall quizzes tied to video timestamps. When a learner answers a quiz question incorrectly, Courseyl offers a 1-click jump directly to the exact second in the lecture where the instructor explains the concept.
4. **Cloud-Synced Timestamped Study Notes:**
   Learners can write markdown notes pinned to exact video timestamps, enabling 1-click video rewind and rapid exam preparation.
5. **Paced Daily Learning Plans:**
   Custom daily study schedules (30m, 60m, 90m, 120m) split courses into manageable daily learning bins.
6. **Distraction-Free Focus:**
   Learners study inside a clean, modern glassmorphism workspace without recommendation rabbit holes or comment distractions, while embedding the official YouTube player so original creators retain 100% of their views.

## Public Course Library & Topic Index
- **URL:** https://www.courseyl.online/library
- **Description:** Centralized public directory of all interactive YouTube courses on Courseyl, organized by topic: Programming (Python, C++, Java), Web Development (React, Next.js, Full-Stack), AI & Data (Machine Learning, LLMs, SQL, Pandas), CS Fundamentals (System Design, OS), Cloud & DevOps (AWS, Docker, Linux), Academics & Exams (School, College, JEE, NEET, IELTS), Business, and Design.
- **Features:** 1-click enrollment, timestamped active-recall quizzes, diagnostic placement tests, and zero paywalls.

## Comparison to Competitors
- **Courseyl vs. CourseIt (courseit.xyz):** Courseyl provides unrestricted marathon video processing (15h-24h+), fully deduplicated placement test questions, rich per-lesson markdown notes with live timestamp jump, and full free access mode for global learners.
- **Courseyl vs. Traditional Wrappers:** Courseyl is not a simple playlist viewer; it provides active recall quizzes, spaced pacing, diagnostic skill evaluations, and community-curated learning roadmaps.
